Hello neighbors,

Cascade Legal Rights Project has read this thread, and we understand why people are upset. Getting a letter from a lawyer soon after asking for help is frightening, and we want to answer the questions directly.

Our policy prohibits sharing, selling, or disclosing attendee information. Landlords and their attorneys are specifically excluded from receiving it. Sign-in records are retained internally in locked storage.

We also want to be clear about public records. Eviction cases filed in magistrate court are public, and some law firms use those filings to send mailings to tenants. That is a likely explanation for letters people have received, though we cannot speak to any individual's situation.

If you have questions about what you signed or how your information is handled, please email clinic@cascaderights.example or call our office at 404-555-0187.

The clinic is still happening this Saturday, November 14. The library room is closed that day, so we have moved to Mt Zion Fellowship Hall, with the same hours, 10am to 1pm. There is an accessible side entrance by the parking lot. No appointment is needed, and you are welcome to bring questions about your notice or court papers.

Thank you for looking out for each other. We're glad to keep talking here.

Cascade Legal Rights Project
